title: Claim
description: An atomic claim extracted from the report. claim_id = sha256(section_id + sentence_text)[:16].

claim_type.description: Only factual claims hard-fail on lack of support

cited_source_ids.description: Stable source_ids cited for this claim

evidence_ids.description: Evidence rows that support this claim

support_status.description: Set by verify_claim_support.py verify: the model verdict when present, otherwise the lexical fallback

support_verification.description: How support_status was decided: model judge verdict; lexical score because no judge ran; no judge needed (speculation); or a deterministic rule (no evidence linked)

model_verdict.description: Judge model verdict for the claim and its cited passages

judge_model.description: Model ID that produced the verdict

verdict_digest.description: Digest of claim text and judged passages; a changed claim or evidence needs a new verdict
